problem_text:
A regional wildlife conservation team must conduct ecological surveys at five distinct research stations.

The travel durations between stations are recorded in minutes:
* Base to Outpost Alpha: 74.8 minutes
* Base to Outpost Beta: 116.3 minutes
* Base to Outpost Gamma: 125.6 minutes
* Base to Outpost Delta: 132.9 minutes
* Outpost Alpha to Outpost Beta: 115.3 minutes
* Outpost Alpha to Outpost Gamma: 187.2 minutes
* Outpost Alpha to Outpost Delta: 107.7 minutes
* Outpost Beta to Outpost Gamma: 132.5 minutes
* Outpost Beta to Outpost Delta: 39.1 minutes
* Outpost Gamma to Outpost Delta: 170.8 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit that commences from the central base, visits every research station precisely one time, and concludes by returning to the point of origin.
